title: Why Email Threads Break: Message-ID, References and the Headers Agents Lose
summary: Email threads live in three headers, not on a server. How Message-ID, In-Reply-To and References rebuild a conversation, what breaks them, and how agents recover.
body_markdown:
TL;DR


Email has no thread object on the wire. Every client and every API rebuilds the conversation from a few headers each time it reads the mail. A thread holds together only if every sender and relay kept those headers intact. This article explains how the rebuild works and which senders break it. It also covers why the subject line is a bad fallback and what to do with a reply that arrives alone.
